basis: C006 records the source-reported key glyph sequence FIRFUMFERENFE; H001 tested DIVINITY but did not test this distinct key family.
The source reports a continuous LP1/14-15 Vigenere run and skip rune ordinals 65,76; the known-page gate is required before any LP2 transfer.
H013 rejected the fixed affine transfer, so this batch changes mechanism family to a source-derived repeating-key stream rather than retuning affine coefficients.
hypothesis: After passing its source-defined LP1/14-15 gate, the fixed FIRFUMFERENFE Vigenere family transfers to LP2 and at least one fixed clock/F branch produces a language-like score stronger than page-wise permutation controls.
mechanistic_basis: Use rune ordinals for the 13-rune source key, subtract the repeating key modulo 29, and test only continuous/page-reset clocks crossed with ciphertext-F consume/free behavior. No key search, skip-mask search, spelling correction or page-specific tuning is added.
falsifiable_predictions: The source tool-input LP1/14-15 ciphertext and independently segmented Plaintext have equal rune counts and match exactly under the source key, with source one-based codepoint coordinates 65 and 76 mapped to rune ordinals 49 and 58, subtractive direction and no clock advance at skips.
If the family transfers to LP2, at least one of four preregistered branches yields a page with maxT-adjusted p<=0.01 against 999 page-wise permutation controls.
Every LP2 branch output re-encrypts to its original rune sequence, and a separate direct arithmetic path reproduces all branch clocks and scores.
A score lead is only an exploratory candidate; absent an independent plaintext prediction it is not a solved page.
page_universe: LP2/0..55 in pinned numeric order; LP2/50 has no registered rune symbols and is excluded from the rune-stream batch.
scope: Known-page source gate plus all 55 applicable LP2 pages (12956 rune positions); LP2/50 remains explicitly inapplicable.
algorithm_version: H014-v1: P=(C-K[t mod13]) mod29 for non-exception positions; source coordinates 65,76 are mapped losslessly to rune ordinals 49,58 before the known gate; in LP2 F ciphertext index0 maps to plaintext F and either consumes or does not consume t; continuous and page-reset branches are both fixed.
parameter_derivation_policy: Key glyphs and source skip coordinates come from the archived source; their rune ordinals are derived from the exact tool-input line before LP2 output inspection. LP2 branches, page order, control seed, score, maxT correction and acceptance are frozen before decoding.
page_and_section_continuity_hypothesis: The source gate is one continuous block. LP2 tests either one continuous key clock over numeric page order or a clock reset per page; literals do not consume t.

scorer_and_acceptance_version.known_gate: Exact 226/226 rune equality, inverse re-encryption and source skip semantics; gate failure is error/inconclusive and does not authorize interpreting LP2 scores.
scorer_and_acceptance_version.score: Per-page mean H009 training-only additive-smoothed unigram log weight; no candidate-specific retuning or language completion.
scorer_and_acceptance_version.controls: 999 independent within-page permutations preserving each page's rune multiset, reused across the four branch cells; standardize each page/branch and compare to the maximum control z across all 220 cells.
scorer_and_acceptance_version.lead: Complete controls and maxT-adjusted p<=0.01 for a page/branch is an exploratory transfer lead only; no plaintext is accepted from score or visual readability.
scorer_and_acceptance_version.negative: No lead after a passing known gate, complete controls and independent replay is negative only for this exact key, direction, four clock/F branches, scorer and permutation null.
scorer_and_acceptance_version.error_or_timeout: Source parse/gate failure, integrity failure, incomplete controls or independent replay failure is error/timeout/inconclusive, never negative.

frozen_before_candidates: The runner writes frozen.json with all hashes, source key, skips, branches, page order, counts, control seed and criteria before decoding LP2 or generating control outputs.

total_budget.origin: Bounded source-gated all-applicable-page transfer test for auto-cycle R006; no budget inherited from previous cycle.

controls: 999 fixed-seed page-wise permutations preserve each LP2 page's rune multiset and length.
Known-page exact reference segmentation is independent of the cipher implementation and uses the source Plaintext block, never cleaned output.
Independent direct decrypt/encrypt arithmetic checks every known and LP2 rune and clock branch.
All non-rune source characters and page boundaries remain outside the key clock and are preserved in derived output.

randomness.role: Permutation controls only; never a key, plaintext, seed or skip selector.

discovery_path: Archived source key/method plus fixed LP2 branch transfer; no brute-force key search and no answer/dictionary access.
independent_validation_path: The source gate and LP2 branches are replayed by direct loops with separate clock and encryption expressions, then checked for exact rune roundtrip and score equality.
correlated_transform_deduplication: The four branches form one registered repeating-key family; page-wise permutations are controls, not additional keys. maxT covers all branch/page cells.
uncovered_parameters: Other keys, key derivations, directions and skip masks
LP2 source-specific plaintext F positions not observable from ciphertext alone
Transposition, geometry, multiplicative and affine composite layers
Independent LP2 plaintext prediction and image-level glyph audit
next_step: If a lead survives controls, freeze its page and an independent plaintext or structural prediction; otherwise move to a new method family without adding keys or skip masks to this run.
note: Known-page source reproduction is a gate and not a new LP2 solution. LP2 score results are diagnostics only.
